name: Jev 1.13
short: TypeSafe AI's System One typed-decision model (not a text LLM): returns noul/choice/score with probabilities in ~0.6s, JevBench 1.5.4 score 72.13, $0.042/M input with free output.
contextWindow: 64K per request (32K state + 32K question); 262K opt-in via header
modalities: Text, JSON or array state in; typed decision out; no image, audio or video
pricingNote: $0.042 per 1M input tokens; output free (no autoregressive generation); ~950 tokens per decision
standout: A calibrated decision engine, not a chatbot: routing, triage and guardrails for a fraction of a cent per call.
tradeoff: It cannot generate text, so the coding and general-reasoning axes barely apply - score it as a component, not a model.
pricingTiers: OpenCode Zen $0.042/M input, output free; free slot jev-1.13-free also available
TypeSafe direct: same $0.042/M input tariff with free output
